name: mutex
description: Guard a shared resource with a distributed lock, using the mutex CLI

interface.longDescription: Take a PostgreSQL-backed advisory lock around work that only one caller may do at a time - a deploy, a migration, a staging environment - hand it back when the work is done, and know before the lease runs out. The same table backs the mutex CLI and the releasetools/mutex GitHub Action, so a lock taken here also blocks CI.
capabilities: Guard an operation with a distributed lock
Report who holds a lock and when it expires
Extend or release a lock that is already held
defaultPrompt: Take a mutex lock on staging while I run this migration.
Who is holding the deploy lock right now?
Release the lock we took on staging.
